en: Multi-view black-and-white postcard showing scenes from the lakeside resort of Fonyód-Sándortelep at Lake Balaton. The front is divided into several photographs: a long stone pier (móló) crowded with bathers leading into the lake; a large building labeled as the Erzsébet girls' orphanage holiday resort; an oval central view of people sunbathing along the pier; a children's holiday camp of the city of Pécs; and a harbor scene with a steamship and small boats at the kikötő (port). The reverse side has printed Hungarian and German text naming Bad Fonyód-Sándortelep and a slogan 'Nyaraljon Fonyódon!' with a Hungarian postage stamp and handwritten Hungarian message and address.
